SS31.name: 虚空鳗
SS31.form: a slender ribbon-like body with a diamond cross-section, a small pointed head, a short mouth, spaced luminescent nodes down the midline
SS31.fins: a continuous low dorsal ridge merging with the tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS31.markings: a single row of luminous nodes along the flank, an unmarked gap behind the head
SS31.colour: 虚空黑底、节点银蓝、边缘消隐

SS32.name: 陨光海蛇
SS32.form: an elongated cylindrical body with a diamond cross-section, a small blunt head, a short mouth, faceted belly plates
SS32.fins: no pectoral fins, a low ridge along the tail
SS32.markings: a line of luminous nodes along the flank, a band crossing the nape
SS32.colour: 铁灰底、陨光青点、腹部暗铜

SS33.name: 星云鳐
SS33.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc, wide wing-like pectoral margins, a short tail, a pair of small cephalic horns, a soft trailing wing edge
SS33.fins: a slender tail with a low dorsal ridge, small pelvic fins
SS33.markings: a soft drifting cloud of luminous points across the disc, a fine rim line along the wing edge
SS33.colour: 深紫底、星云银雾、翼缘冷光

SS34.name: 渊影鲛
SS34.form: a deep torpedo-shaped body, a long pointed snout, a row of even triangular teeth, five gill slits, a keeled flank
SS34.fins: a low second dorsal fin, a crescent-shaped tail fin, long pectoral fins
SS34.markings: a faint sheen line along the flank, a single mark at the gill slits
SS34.colour: 渊黑底、影银侧线、背鳍深灰

SS35.name: 深星章鱼
SS35.form: an elongated mantle with a diamond cross-section, a pair of triangular side fins, a compact head, four arm pairs in even grouping, a row of luminous pores on the mantle
SS35.fins: a pair of triangular side fins running along the mantle
SS35.markings: a row of luminous pores along the mantle, a faint seam behind the eye
SS35.colour: 深靛底、星点幽蓝、外套膜冷光

SS36.name: 陨落灯笼
SS36.form: a stout rounded body with faceted plates, a large head, a wide mouth, a short chin barbel ending in a single bead, a blunt snout
SS36.fins: a low dorsal fin, small rounded pectoral fins, a rounded tail fin
SS36.markings: a single glowing bead at the barbel tip, a faint seam along the jaw
SS36.colour: 暗褐底、陨落橙点、喉部幽光

SS37.name: 星蚀鲷
SS37.form: a deep oval body, a steep forehead, a small mouth, a large eye, a raised ridge along the back
SS37.fins: a spined dorsal fin with even triangular peaks, a slightly forked tail fin
SS37.markings: a ring-shaped eclipse mark behind the eye, a faint band crossing the nape
SS37.colour: 墨蓝底、蚀环银边、背部暗影

SS38.name: 虚时鲳
SS38.form: a deep oval body, a small head, a short blunt snout, a small mouth, a still even surface with faint set ring seams
SS38.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS38.markings: a set of frozen ripple bands across the flank, a single ring near the nape
SS38.colour: 灰蓝底、凝时暗环、腹部冷银

SS39.name: 碎陨皇带
SS39.form: an extremely long ribbon-like body with a diamond cross-section, a small blunt head, a short mouth, a trailing crest of even spaced rays along the back, a row of luminous pores at the crest base
SS39.fins: a low crest of even rays along the entire back, tiny pectoral fins, a small fan tail fin
SS39.markings: a scatter of broken luminous fragments along the flank, a fine seam at the crest base
SS39.colour: 深靛底、碎陨银屑、脊冠冷光

SS40.name: 星纱水母
SS40.form: a wide sheer bell with evenly spaced rim lobes, a ring of luminous nodes just inside the rim, four grouped trailing tentacles
SS40.markings: a ring of luminous nodes inside the bell rim, faint radial seams on the dome
SS40.colour: 深靛底、星纱银雾、伞缘微光
